figures.finding: Seychelles has no performer's permit: no one may employ a person under fifteen, in any work; under eighteen no one may be employed in a hotel, restaurant, shop, bar, nightclub, dance-hall, discotheque or similar place of entertainment, or between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m., save the competent officer's exceptional special written permission for those aged fifteen to seventeen. The floor holds for any employment, so it reaches a young writer or director as well.
figures.applies: The 2010 edition; amendments of 2015, 2018 and 2019 listed on the Ministry's page weren't read.

sources.said: another of less than 15 years of age. 22.(1) A person shall not employ another under the age of 18 years in a hotel, guest-house, boarding house, any place where tourists are accommodated, restaurant, shop, bar, nightclub, dance-hall, discotheque or similar place of entertainment or on a ship or aircraft.

(4) Notwithstanding subregulations (1) and (2) the competent officer’ may, exceptionally, grant special written permission for the employment of any person aged 15 to 17 years in a place listed in subregulation (1) or between the hours of 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.
